The absence of ulceration, induration, rapid growth, or dermal mitoses rules out invasive squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) or SCC in situ (Bowen disease, which typically shows full-thickness atypia but often lacks solar elastosis as prominently and may be more variable in clinical presentation). All evidence converges robustly on AK as the singular, most likely diagnosis.

Actinic Keratosis
